recursive_query_egress_filtering_enabled.title: Recursive Query Egress Filtering Enabled
recursive_query_egress_filtering_enabled.description: Indicates whether egress filtering rules are applied to outbound recursive DNS queries from internal resolvers, blocking or inspecting traffic on DNS ports (53, 853, 443) to untrusted external destinations.

dns_over_https_allowed_unrestricted.title: DNS-over-HTTPS Allowed Without Restriction
dns_over_https_allowed_unrestricted.description: Indicates whether internal resolvers or endpoints are permitted to initiate DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) connections to arbitrary external servers without proxy inspection or an allowlist, enabling covert channel abuse over port 443.

inter_zone_dns_traffic_monitored.title: Inter-Zone DNS Traffic Monitored
inter_zone_dns_traffic_monitored.description: Indicates whether DNS traffic crossing zone boundaries is captured and analyzed for anomalies such as high-entropy subdomains, oversized TXT records, or unusual query volumes consistent with DNS tunneling or exfiltration.

txt_record_payload_size_limit_enforced.title: TXT Record Payload Size Limit Enforced
txt_record_payload_size_limit_enforced.description: Indicates whether the DNS infrastructure enforces a maximum payload size restriction on TXT record responses to prevent encoded data exfiltration via oversized TXT records used as covert channel carriers.

smtp_relay_source_zone_restriction.title: SMTP Relay Source Zone Restriction Enforced
smtp_relay_source_zone_restriction.description: Indicates whether the SMTP relay service enforces strict source trust zone restrictions, permitting relay only from explicitly authorized zones and rejecting connections from all other zones.

accepted_source_trust_zones.title: Accepted Source Trust Zones for SMTP Relay
accepted_source_trust_zones.description: List of trust zone identifiers (e.g., 'dmz', 'internal', 'external', 'management') from which the SMTP relay currently accepts inbound SMTP connections.

relay_smtp_port_ingress_filter_present.title: SMTP Relay Ingress Filter Present on Zone Boundary
relay_smtp_port_ingress_filter_present.description: Indicates whether an ingress filter (firewall rule, ACL, or security group) is applied at the zone boundary that restricts which source zones can reach the SMTP relay on port 25/587/465.

axfr_allowed_source_restriction.title: AXFR/IXFR Source Restriction Level
axfr_allowed_source_restriction.description: Indicates whether zone transfer requests are restricted by source IP ACL to only authorized secondary nameservers within the authoritative segment, unrestricted (any host), or restricted but crossing segment boundaries.

tsig_authentication_enforced.title: TSIG Authentication Enforced
tsig_authentication_enforced.description: Whether TSIG (Transaction Signature) or equivalent cryptographic authentication is required on all AXFR/IXFR zone transfer requests and dynamic DNS update requests, ensuring only keyed authorized parties can receive zone data or submit record modifications.

boundary_firewall_blocks_axfr.title: Boundary Firewall Blocks AXFR/IXFR Between Segments
boundary_firewall_blocks_axfr.description: Whether a network boundary control (firewall, security group, ACL) explicitly denies DNS zone transfer traffic (TCP port 53 used for AXFR/IXFR) from leaving the authoritative DNS segment toward lower-trust or adjacent zones.

split_horizon_views_configured.title: Split-Horizon DNS Views Configured
split_horizon_views_configured.description: Indicates whether the DNS server has split-horizon (split-view) configuration defined, separating internal and external zone responses.

view_acl_overlap_present.title: View ACL Overlap Present
view_acl_overlap_present.description: Indicates whether the ACL (match-clients or match-destinations) definitions across DNS views contain overlapping or ambiguous address ranges, allowing external clients to match an internal view.

ingress_filter_enforces_dns_view_boundar.title: Ingress Filter Enforces DNS View Boundary
ingress_filter_enforces_dns_view_boundar.description: Indicates whether the network ingress filtering (firewall, ACL, or security group) actively restricts DNS queries on port 53 to ensure external sources cannot reach the internal-facing DNS resolver or its zone data.

credential_zone_scope.title: Credential Zone Scope
credential_zone_scope.description: Indicates whether the service account or API credentials used by DNS/email services are scoped to a single trust zone or shared across multiple trust zones.

cross_zone_credential_reuse_enforced_pre.title: Cross-Zone Credential Reuse Prevention Enforced
cross_zone_credential_reuse_enforced_pre.description: Whether a technical control (e.g., workload identity binding, network policy, token scope restriction) actively prevents credentials issued in one zone from being accepted or reused in a different trust zone.

credential_rotation_independent_per_zone.title: Credentials Rotated Independently Per Zone
credential_rotation_independent_per_zone.description: Whether DNS and email service credentials are rotated independently for each trust zone, ensuring a compromised credential in one zone does not remain valid in another.

management_service_plane_isolated.title: Management and Service Plane Network Isolation Enforced
management_service_plane_isolated.description: Indicates whether an enforced network boundary (e.g., separate VLAN, firewall zone rule, or ACL) exists between the management plane and the service plane for DNS/email infrastructure, preventing direct reachability between the two. Management and service plane segments are considered the same when no such isolation exists.

dynamic_update_acl_zone_scoped.title: Dynamic Update ACL Zone-Scoped
dynamic_update_acl_zone_scoped.description: Whether dynamic DNS update ACLs (RFC 2136) are scoped to specific zones, restricting which source IPs or TSIG keys may update each individual zone rather than applying a global allow policy.

update_source_segment_restricted.title: Dynamic Update Sources Restricted to Authorized Segments
update_source_segment_restricted.description: Whether dynamic update requests are filtered at the network or DNS server level to only permit source IP ranges belonging to the specific zone's authorized (same-trust-level) segment, blocking lower-trust segments from sending updates.

zone_boundary_inspection_enabled.title: Zone Boundary Traffic Inspection Enabled
zone_boundary_inspection_enabled.description: Whether dedicated inspection (IDS/IPS, firewall with deep packet inspection) is deployed at the boundary between foundational service segments (DNS/email) and adjacent trust zones.

dns_query_telemetry_captured_at_egress.title: DNS Query Telemetry Captured at Zone Egress
dns_query_telemetry_captured_at_egress.description: Whether DNS query metadata (source IP, queried domain, query type, response code, resolver tier) is logged or streamed at the zone egress boundary rather than only at the resolver itself.

smtp_session_metadata_captured_at_egress.title: SMTP Session Metadata Captured at Zone Egress
smtp_session_metadata_captured_at_egress.description: Whether SMTP session metadata (envelope sender/recipient, session IP, TLS negotiation outcome, message-ID) is logged at the zone egress point for the email service segment.

inter_zone_anomaly_detection_configured.title: Inter-Zone Anomaly Detection Configured
inter_zone_anomaly_detection_configured.description: Whether automated anomaly detection rules or behavioral analytics are applied specifically to inter-zone traffic flows involving the DNS and email foundational service segments.

mta_strips_external_received_headers.title: MTA Strips External Received Headers at Zone Boundary
mta_strips_external_received_headers.description: Whether the mail transfer agent at the zone ingress boundary removes or sanitizes Received headers and internal routing metadata originating from lower-trust zones before forwarding messages to higher-trust zone recipients.

zone_trust_classification_enforced_in_fi.title: Zone-Aware Trust Classification Enforced in Mail Filtering
zone_trust_classification_enforced_in_fi.description: Whether downstream mail filtering policies explicitly evaluate zone origin metadata and apply differentiated trust levels based on the originating network zone rather than treating all internal messages as equally trusted.

inter_zone_mta_relay_authentication.title: Inter-Zone MTA Relay Authentication Method
inter_zone_mta_relay_authentication.description: The authentication method enforced between MTAs when relaying messages across zone boundaries, indicating whether message origin can be cryptographically verified.

cross_zone_forwarder_configured.title: Cross-Zone DNS Forwarder Configured
cross_zone_forwarder_configured.description: Indicates whether a DNS forwarder in one trust zone is configured to forward queries to a resolver in a different trust zone, enabling cross-zone query traversal.

per_hop_acl_enforced.title: Per-Hop ACL Enforced on Forwarder Chain
per_hop_acl_enforced.description: Indicates whether access control lists or firewall rules are applied at each forwarder hop in the chain to restrict which sources can issue queries and which destinations can receive forwarded queries.

internal_zone_resolvable_from_external_f.title: Internal Zone Names Resolvable via External Forwarder
internal_zone_resolvable_from_external_f.description: Indicates whether an external or lower-trust zone DNS forwarder can successfully resolve internal zone DNS names by leveraging the forwarder chain, exposing internal topology.
